FAR_TRANS.TRANSACTIONS.purpose: Records all buy and sell transactions of financial assets by customers across different channels and markets.

FAR_TRANS.CLOSE_PRICES.purpose: Stores daily closing prices for financial assets identified by ISIN over time.
FAR_TRANS.CLOSE_PRICES.grain: one row per asset per day

FAR_TRANS.CUSTOMER_INFORMATION.purpose: Tracks customer profile attributes including type, risk level, and investment capacity over time.
FAR_TRANS.CUSTOMER_INFORMATION.grain: one row per customer per profile change date

FAR_TRANS.V_CUSTOMER_CURRENT.purpose: Stores the current state of customer profiles including risk assessment and investment capacity classifications.
FAR_TRANS.V_CUSTOMER_CURRENT.grain: one row per customer at their most recent timestamp

FAR_TRANS.LIMIT_PRICES.purpose: Stores minimum and maximum price points for each asset over time with calculated profitability metrics.
FAR_TRANS.LIMIT_PRICES.grain: one row per asset (ISIN) with its historical price range

FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION.purpose: Stores comprehensive reference information about financial assets including classification and market details.
FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION.grain: one row per asset (ISIN) at a specific timestamp

FAR_TRANS.V_ASSET_CURRENT.purpose: Stores the current state of financial assets including stocks, bonds, and ETFs with their categorization and market information.
FAR_TRANS.V_ASSET_CURRENT.grain: one row per asset (ISIN) at its current state

FAR_TRANS.MARKETS.purpose: Stores information about financial exchanges and markets including trading hours, location, and classification.
FAR_TRANS.MARKETS.grain: one row per market or exchange
